$comment: Harness x model matrix for scripts/eval-matrix.mjs (Harbor). Each entry is run twice per case: once with the skill installed and once without. Edit `entries` to change models or effort. `model` is a Harbor model name: `anthropic/<id>`, `openai/<id>`, or `openrouter/<provider>/<id>` for any model on OpenRouter. `effort` is the reasoning effort for the agent (claude-code: low, medium, high, xhigh, max; codex: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max; opencode: a variant name the model defines); null leaves the agent's default. `key` is the environment variable holding the API key. Optional `version` pins the agent CLI version.
